tinker_laser.desc: Fires a laser at an enemy unit. It takes pure damage and is blinded, so its attacks miss for a few seconds.

tinker_march_of_the_machines.desc: Tinker calls in a stream of small robots that march through a large square centred on him, in the direction of the target point. A robot explodes on the first enemy it touches and damages enemies around it.

tinker_deploy_turrets.desc: Drops a crate of three uncontrollable turrets at the target point. The impact damages enemies and pushes them away; Tinker is pushed too if he stands in the blast. Each turret fires rockets toward the nearest enemy hero until it expires.

tinker_keen_teleport.desc: Channel, then teleport next to the friendly structure closest to the target point. The level follows Rearm: level 2 also allows allied units, level 3 allied heroes.

tinker_rearm.desc: Channel to reset the cooldowns of Tinker's abilities and of the items he carries.

tinker_eureka.desc: Intelligence shortens item cooldowns: 1% per 3 Intelligence, up to 60%.

fields.utub: An uncontrollable turret deployed by Tinker.
